title: Generic-fibre triviality over a valuation ring
statement: Let A be a valuation ring with fraction field K, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let X_0 be its integral closed fibre [def-pc-integral-scheme], and let L be an invertible module on X [def-sc-invertible-module]. If H^0(X_K,\mathcal O_{X_K})=K and the restriction of L to the generic fibre X_K is trivial, then L is trivial on X.

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-valuation-generic-trivializing-generator to obtain a section s and a bijection a maps to a s from A to its global sections; its zero ideal pulls back to the unit ideal on the generic fibre.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma lemma-triviality-generic-fibre-valuation-ring, Tag 0EX8, general-case proof

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-valuation-closed-fibre-divisibility. It identifies the integral closed fibre and says that a section restricting to zero is pi times t with pi in m. If s restricts to zero, write t=a s by the basis bijection. Then s=pi a s and injectivity of that same bijection gives pi a=1. The ideal m contains pi a, contradicting its properness. Thus s restricts nontrivially. Apply valuation_zero_section_relative_cartier at the closed point; its flatness clause gives Flat(Z(s) to Spec A).

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma lemma-triviality-generic-fibre-valuation-ring, Tag 0EX8, general-case proof

proof.text: The image eta of the point of Spec K has zero prime ideal, since A to K is injective, so closure{eta}=Spec A. Suppose x belongs to the support of J=Z(s). Lift it to a point z of its closed subscheme using range_subschemeι. Mathlib Flat.generalizingMap lifts eta specializing to the image of z to a point z-prime of Z(s) over eta. Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback then provides a point of X_K projecting to the image of z-prime in X. The support_comap identity puts this point in the support of J pulled back to X_K. That ideal is the unit ideal, whose support is empty, a contradiction. Hence the support of J is empty. The proved source-library isFreeGenerator_app_one_of_le applies on the whole scheme; homOfGlobalSection_app_one identifies its generator with s. Finally isIso_homOfGlobalSection supplies an isomorphism O_X to L, and its inverse gives the claimed L to O_X. All these steps are written explicitly in Lean; no additional unproved statement is used.
